Thể tích cần tìm là:\\
		$V = \pi \displaystyle \int_0^2 \left(3^x-1\right)^2\,dx = \pi \displaystyle \int_0^2 \left(3^{2x} - 2 \cdot 3^x + 1\right)\,dx = \pi \left. \left( \displaystyle \frac{9^x}{\ln 9} - \displaystyle \frac{2 \cdot 3^x}{\ln 3} + x \right) \right|_0^2 = \pi \left( \displaystyle \frac{24}{\ln 3} + 2 \right) \approx 74,9$.
